purpose: Define a mostly-local, evidence-first EXTRACT architecture and promotion benchmark before any new heavyweight model/runtime download. The objective is to make STANDARD Codex a rare fail-closed fallback while preserving exact authoritative-PDF provenance and the already-accepted VERIFY production route.

problem_definition.current_job: EXTRACT is an open-ended scientific evidence extraction job over one acquired paper, not a fixed enterprise field schema.
semantic_requirements: raw_source_form must be an exact source-grounded quote that can be deterministically located on the authoritative PDF page
normalized_form must express an atomic, scientifically useful claim supported by the quote/context
type must remain semantically compatible with downstream evidence use
page_number and source provenance must be exact
the pipeline must seek relevant evidence comprehensively enough that high precision alone cannot hide systematic omissions
problem_definition.prior_failure_boundary: The prior Qwen3.5-4B grounded-candidate EXTRACT architecture passed provenance guards but failed semantic-equivalence controls decisively. Repeating the same one-shot/bounded-context architecture or cosmetic prompt variants is forbidden.

inherited_production_assets: Docling native lexical/order substrate plus standard_no_ocr structure overlay
TableFormer FAST -> ACCURATE -> PP-TableMagic targeted table recovery
shared local inference broker and bounded queue/backpressure semantics
accepted page-scoped Qwen VERIFY route with whole-job STANDARD Codex fallthrough
exclusions: no rerun of the prior Qwen3.5-4B grounded-candidate EXTRACT architecture as-is
no global OCR or VLM-on-every-page design
no PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 general semantic solution absent materially new evidence addressing its prior failures
no replacement of accepted native/Docling/formula/table components without a new measured residual
no new heavyweight download before this contract is durable and the first-wave candidate set is explicitly selected

external_design_evidence.implication: Leading extraction systems use agentic decomposition, structural document representations, cross-page inspection, intermediate representations, source-return tools, grounding/citations and confidence rather than relying only on one-shot generation.

Exact source grounding can be implemented around a model: long text is chunked, extraction is parallel/multipass, and outputs are mapped back to exact source character spans; local model providers are supported.

Compact schema-driven encoders can cheaply propose entities, classifications, records and relations and can serve as candidate-span/type detectors without asking a generative model to rediscover every source span.
Scientific claim processing can be decomposed into retrieval/rationale selection and claim/evidence verification, with public claim-generation data from citation contexts.

Teacher-generated labels can train substantially cheaper task models; future Codex fallbacks should be captured as supervised local training/evaluation data rather than treated only as recurring remote calls.

architecture.principle: Use the cheapest reliable local stage to reduce uncertainty. Preserve exact candidate/source provenance at every transition. Escalate only unresolved units. A stronger model never gets authority to invent an unlocatable source quote.

stages.role: Reuse accepted sidecar/native/structure data to expose page, section, block, sentence, table, formula and figure locators.
stages.model_requirement: none beyond already accepted production components

stages.role: Generate multiple evidence-seeking queries from the research topic, retained item rationale/title and document sections; retrieve candidate page/block/sentence regions using deterministic lexical search first and an optional compact local cross-encoder reranker.
first_wave_candidates: existing PostgreSQL/text search and deterministic section heuristics
BGE-reranker-v2-m3 or equivalent compact cross-encoder only if deterministic retrieval recall is inadequate
stages.output_contract: ranked source regions with exact page/block/span identity and retrieval/rerank scores
stages.failure_action: broaden local retrieval passes before semantic escalation

stages.role: Propose exact source spans, candidate evidence classes, records and relations without normalizing them into final scientific claims yet.
first_wave_candidates: GLiNER2.5-base-v1 (194M) or equivalent compact schema-driven encoder
stages.output_contract: exact candidate spans/records with offsets, page identity, local scores and candidate labels
stages.failure_action: retain candidate region for local generative inspection rather than inventing a span

stages.role: Convert one or a very small set of already-located source spans plus bounded local context into atomic normalized claims and candidate types. This stage does not discover source quotes.
first_wave_candidates: existing certified Qwen3.5-4B runtime in a materially narrower role than the rejected end-to-end EXTRACT architecture
second_wave_candidates: NuExtract3 4B as a bounded text/region structured-extraction comparator
Lift 9B as a bounded document/region structured-extraction comparator after license/runtime review
stages.output_contract: normalized_form, candidate type, confidence, and references only to supplied exact source spans
stages.hard_guard: raw_source_form is copied from the supplied source span by deterministic code, never accepted from free model generation

stages.role: Test whether each normalized claim is supported by its exact quote plus bounded scientific context; detect contradiction, unsupported abstraction and type mismatch.
first_wave_candidates: MultiVerS/SciFact-style scientific claim verifier or equivalent local NLI/rationale model
existing bounded Qwen VERIFY capability may be evaluated as an additional independent guard only if its pre-materialization input/output contract is explicit
stages.output_contract: support/contradict/insufficient decision, confidence and evidence span identity
stages.failure_action: reject or escalate; never materialize unsupported claim

stages.role: Evaluate whether the local evidence set appears complete enough for the paper/task: compare independent retrieval/query passes, unresolved high-score regions, duplicate/conflicting claims and section coverage.
stages.output_contract: job-local completion decision plus unresolved region/claim list

stages.role: Optional stronger local reasoning agent receives only unresolved regions plus sidecar search/read/locate tools. It may request more source regions but cannot bypass exact grounding/verification guards.
stages.candidate_after_first_wave_failure: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B or another stronger efficient local model only after quantized dual-A4500 feasibility and license/runtime review
stages.output_contract: new grounded candidate claims or explicit abstentions

stages.role: Authoritative-PDF semantic fallback for unresolved job/regions. Results are used both for normal downstream evidence materialization and as teacher/evaluation data for the local pipeline.
stages.target_frequency: rare after promotion; measured, never assumed

first_wave_candidate_policy.purpose: Test the architecture with the smallest new dependency burden before opening another heavyweight bakeoff.
reuse_without_download: existing certified Qwen3.5-4B runtime/model in claim-normalization-only role
existing PostgreSQL and Python text/search infrastructure
small_new_candidates_allowed_after_contr: GLiNER2.5-base-v1 or equivalent compact schema IE encoder
BGE-reranker-v2-m3 only if retrieval recall measurements justify it
first_wave_candidate_policy.rationale: If decomposition plus lightweight components already turns the existing Qwen runtime into a reliable normalizer/verifier, avoid adding another heavyweight owner. Open specialized/stronger models only against measured residuals.

benchmark_dataset.primary: preserved historical production-like EXTRACT jobs whose authoritative PDFs and STANDARD Codex results remain available
benchmark_dataset.teacher_control: existing/preserved STANDARD Codex EXTRACT outputs are comparison labels, not scientific ground truth when source evidence disagrees
benchmark_dataset.evaluation_unit: claim plus exact source quote/page/type; also score whole-job local-completion/fallback decision
benchmark_dataset.future_data_loop: Every production Codex fallback that passes normal verification may be retained in a separate versioned teacher dataset with source artifact identity and extractor version for later local fine-tuning/evaluation.

hard_safety: exact_quote_locatability == 1.0 for every locally accepted claim
production_promotion: no material regression in downstream VERIFY outcome on locally completed jobs
target_after_teacher_adaptation: job_local_completion_fraction >= 0.90 while retaining production precision/grounding gates
gates.interpretation: A candidate may be useful research at lower local-completion rates, but production promotion requires Codex to be the minority path. Quality and provenance are hard gates; savings never compensate for scientific regression.

teacher_data_policy.source: STANDARD Codex fallback outputs plus authoritative PDF/source locators and subsequent verification outcome
teacher_data_policy.purpose: continually improve local retrieval, candidate labeling and normalization on the engine's actual scientific distribution
exclusions: do not train on unverified or source-inconsistent remote outputs as truth
do not mix teacher labels from changed schemas/prompts without version metadata
do not silently overwrite benchmark holdout cases
candidate_training_targets: span/type labels for compact IE models
teacher_data_policy.holdout: Preserve paper-level holdouts so reduced fallback is not measured on teacher examples seen during adaptation.

resource_policy.existing_global_default: Respect the production residual-escalation owner limits unless a later evidence-backed resource redesign is explicitly authorized.
resource_policy.lightweight_components: Prefer CPU or <=4 GiB VRAM and persistent/shared ownership.
resource_policy.existing_qwen_owner: Reuse certified owner/runtime; do not create a duplicate model process.
resource_policy.new_heavy_owner: Must pass license/runtime review, bounded cold/warm resource gate and broker integration before production consideration.
resource_policy.hard_case_agent: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is feasibility-only at contract stage because official recipes do not establish RTX A4500 compatibility; no weights download until residual need and quantized deployment plan are explicit.

next_sequence: CI-lock this contract without production routing changes.
Build a zero-materialization offline dataset adapter over preserved EXTRACT jobs and authoritative source regions.
Measure deterministic retrieval baseline before adding a reranker.
Prototype exact-span candidate extraction and existing-Qwen claim-normalization-only role.
Add a local scientific verifier and completeness audit.
Measure claim quality, provenance and job-local completion/fallback fraction.
Only if measured residuals justify it, open one specialized extractor or stronger local-agent candidate at a time.
Capture future Codex fallbacks as versioned teacher data and reassess local completion on untouched holdouts.
Change production routing only after a separate Lambda integration/acceptance gate.
